facts.en: Completed a BA in Language Studies at Fictional Institute D076 in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构院校 D076 完成语言研究文学学士学位。

facts.en: Worked as a customer onboarding assistant at Fictional Learning Software D076 from 2021-02 to 2023-06.
facts.zh: 2021-02 至 2023-06 在虚构学习软件企业 D076 担任客户入门助理。

facts.en: Moved to customer education assistant at the same employer from 2023-07 to 2026-08; this was a role change, not a second concurrent paid job.
facts.zh: 2023-07 至 2026-08 在同一雇主转任客户教育助理；这是岗位变更，而非第二份并行有偿工作。

facts.en: In the earlier role, scheduled onboarding calls and distributed approved setup instructions.
facts.zh: 在早期岗位安排入门电话，并分发获批设置说明。

facts.en: In the education role, coordinated webinar calendars and maintained attendee-registration records.
facts.zh: 在教育岗位协调网络研讨会日历，并维护参与者报名记录。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet filters and the webinar platform to check registrations and send approved reminders.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格筛选及网络研讨会平台检查报名并发送获批提醒。

facts.en: Worked with a trainer to revise a beginner workbook during 2024-10 to 2025-01.
facts.zh: 在 2024-10 至 2025-01 与培训师合作修订初学者工作手册。

facts.en: The candidate edited navigation instructions and checked screenshots; the trainer authored learning objectives and approved teaching content.
facts.zh: 候选人编辑导航说明并检查截图；培训师撰写学习目标并批准教学内容。

facts.en: Across 8 sessions in 2025-Q1, 11 of 96 returned forms flagged unclear navigation, compared with 20 of 90 forms in the preceding 8 sessions; session audiences differed.
facts.zh: 在 2025-Q1 的 8 场课程中，收回的 96 份表格有 11 份指出导航不清，之前 8 场的 90 份表格中有 20 份；课程受众不同。

facts.en: The form comparison is a descriptive team observation, not proof that the workbook caused learning gains.
facts.zh: 表格比较是团队描述性观察，不证明工作手册导致学习进步。

facts.en: Coordinated delivery of 4 approved refresher webinars in 2026-02, handling invitations and attendance rather than teaching.
facts.zh: 在 2026-02 协调交付 4 场获批复习网络研讨会，负责邀请及出勤，而非授课。

facts.en: Drafted a self-paced course storyboard in 2026-05; it was reviewed but never published or recorded.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草自主学习课程分镜；经审阅但从未发布或录制。

facts.en: Prepared accessible text summaries of video instructions for trainer review.
facts.zh: 准备视频说明的易读文本摘要，供培训师审阅。

facts.en: At the 2025-09 launch peak, coordinated 7 webinar sessions monthly; the normal 2026-08 schedule was 3.
facts.zh: 在 2025-09 发布高峰期，每月协调 7 场网络研讨会；2026-08 常规安排为 3 场。

facts.en: Completed a 2025-11 short course on learning objectives using fictional lesson examples; it was not employment or a teaching licence.
facts.zh: 2025-11 完成使用虚构课程示例的学习目标短课；并非任职或教学执照。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Language Circle V076 on Saturdays from 2024-03 to 2024-12 while retaining the paid education role.
facts.zh: 2024-03 至 2024-12 保留有偿教育岗位期间，星期六在虚构语言社团 V076 志愿服务。

facts.en: At the circle, arranged room bookings and shared conversation prompts; no formal learner assessment was performed.
facts.zh: 在该社团安排房间预约并分享对话提示；未执行正式学员评估。

facts.en: Created a personal illustrated guide to imaginary train stations in 2022; it was unrelated to customer training.
facts.zh: 2022 年制作个人虚构车站插画指南；与客户培训无关。

facts.en: Keeps a home herb-drying notebook as a hobby, without selling products.
facts.zh: 以爱好方式保留家庭香草干燥笔记，不销售产品。

facts.en: Logged unanswered attendee questions and routed product questions to support specialists.
facts.zh: 记录未回答的参与者问题，并将产品问题转交支持专家。

facts.en: A draft biography calls the candidate a certified instructional designer, but the retained evidence is only the short-course completion notice.
facts.zh: 一份简介草稿称候选人为认证教学设计师，但留存证据仅为短课结业通知。

facts.en: No independent course assessment design, video production ownership or trainer-management authority is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录独立课程评估设计、视频制作负责或培训师管理权限。
